title: Media Upload System (Self-Hosted VPS)
description: Self-hosted media upload system on VPS (Hostinger 100GB NVMe). Uses multer for multipart uploads and sharp for image optimization. Generates 3 variants per image: original (WebP), medium (800x600), thumbnail (400x300). No external dependency (Cloudinary/S3). Migration path to AWS S3 when needed.
endpoints: GET /inventory/:id/media - List all media with variant URLs
features: Auto-converts all uploads to WebP for smaller file size
Static file serving via /uploads with 7-day cache
Lightbox gallery on property detail page with prev/next navigation
migration_note: To move to AWS: swap StorageService internals to use S3 SDK, keep same interface
